news.titleEn: Oil gains over 1% as Trump rejects Iranian proposal to reopen Hormuz Strait
news.conclusionEn: Oil jumped on Monday after Trump rejected Iran's seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz; Brent touched $108.83 intraday before settling near $105.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普拒绝伊朗重开霍尔木兹方案，布油盘中触及108美元
news.whyEn: With Hormuz still shut, energy costs stay elevated, feeding inflation, pushing up bond yields and weighing on stocks and oil-importing economies.
news.whyZh: 海峡持续封闭推高能源成本，加剧通胀、推升债息并压制股市和石油进口国
news.detailEn: Brent rose nearly 3% in Asian trading to above $107 before paring gains to close around $105.28, while WTI settled near $92.60. Iran's conditions included lifting the US naval blockade, releasing frozen assets and ending what it calls US aggression. The Wall Street Journal reported Trump told aides he expects strikes on Iran to resume after the November midterms. Traders now see little near-term chance of the strait reopening, keeping a war premium in crude.
news.detailZh: 布伦特原油亚洲时段一度大涨近3%至107美元以上，最终收于约105.28美元，WTI收于约92.60美元。伊朗提出的条件包括解除美国海上封锁、释放冻结资产和停止所谓「侵略行为」。据《华尔街日报》报道，特朗普告诉幕僚预计中期选举后将恢复对伊朗的打击。市场认为海峡短期内重开希望渺茫，原油战争溢价将持续。

news.titleEn: Treasury yields rise as march to multiyear highs continues
news.conclusionEn: The 10-year Treasury yield climbed about 5 basis points to roughly 5.23%, its highest since mid-2007, while the Dow fell 0.7% and the S&P 500 0.8%.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10年期国债收益率升至约5.23%，创2007年以来新高
news.whyEn: Higher long-term rates raise borrowing costs for mortgages, companies and governments and pressure equity valuations worldwide.
news.whyZh: 长端利率走高推升房贷、企业和政府融资成本，压制全球股市估值
news.detailEn: The bond selloff resumed as the oil rally revived inflation fears; the 30-year yield rose to about 5.55% and the 2-year to about 4.93%. Heavy government and AI-related corporate bond issuance and bets on another Fed hike have added to the pressure. The Dow closed at 51,481.51, the S&P 500 at 7,683.69 and the Nasdaq at 26,820.38. Quarter-end on Wednesday and Friday's September jobs report are the next tests for markets.
news.detailZh: 油价上涨重燃通胀担忧，美债抛售再起，30年期收益率升至约5.55%，2年期升至约4.93%。政府和AI相关企业大量发债，加上市场押注美联储再次加息，共同推高收益率。道指收于51481.51点，标普500收于7683.69点，纳指收于26820.38点。周三季末和周五9月非农就业报告将是市场的下一个考验。

news.titleEn: US and China agree to cut tariffs on $60 billion worth of goods
news.conclusionEn: Under a "30-for-30" framework, the US and China will each import $30 billion of the other's non-sensitive goods at reduced tariffs, following last week's Trump–Xi meeting.
news.conclusionZh: 中美按「30对30」框架，互降共600亿美元商品关税
news.whyEn: It is the most concrete trade de-escalation between the two largest economies in months, affecting farmers, retailers and commodity exporters.
news.whyZh: 这是全球两大经济体数月来最实质的贸易缓和，影响农户、零售商和大宗出口商
news.detailEn: China's list covers 1,619 US items including corn, wheat, frozen meat, seafood, wood, cosmetics and medical devices, but notably excludes soybeans. The US list covers 77 Chinese items such as toys, tableware, kitchen accessories and electric shavers. China also pledged to import at least 10 million tonnes of US coal in both 2027 and 2028. A new agriculture working group will meet before year-end to discuss further market access.
news.detailZh: 中方清单涵盖1619项美国商品，包括玉米、小麦、冻肉、海鲜、木材、化妆品和医疗器械，但未包括大豆。美方清单涵盖77项中国商品，如玩具、餐具、厨房用品和电动剃须刀。中国还承诺2027和2028年每年进口至少1000万吨美国煤炭。双方将成立农业工作组，年底前召开首次会议讨论进一步市场准入。

news.titleEn: Nvidia share buyback plan gets $150 billion boost
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia added $150 billion to its share repurchase authorization, bringing the total to $235 billion — the largest buyback increase in US corporate history.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达追加1500亿美元回购，总额达2350亿创美国纪录
news.whyEn: It signals how much cash the AI boom is generating and supports Nvidia's stock, a key driver of global indexes.
news.whyZh: 显示AI热潮带来的巨额现金流，并支撑这只影响全球指数的龙头股
news.detailEn: The increase beats Apple's $110 billion record set in 2024, and Nvidia expects to complete the remaining program through fiscal 2028. CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC the world is in "the largest infrastructure build-out in human history" and Nvidia wants to return growing cash to shareholders. The shares rose about 1.7% on a down day for the market. Critics argue such buybacks favor shareholders over investment and wages.
news.detailZh: 此次增幅超过苹果2024年创下的1100亿美元纪录，英伟达预计在2028财年前完成剩余回购。CEO黄仁勋对CNBC表示，世界正处于「人类史上最大规模的基础设施建设」，公司希望把不断增长的现金回馈股东。在大盘下跌的一天，英伟达股价上涨约1.7%。批评者认为大规模回购偏向股东，而非投资和员工薪酬。

news.titleEn: AMD acquiring Fei-Fei Li's World Labs AI firm in deal worth $8.2 billion
news.conclusionEn: AMD agreed to buy spatial-intelligence startup World Labs for $8.2 billion in stock, with founder Fei-Fei Li becoming AMD's chief scientist.
news.conclusionZh: AMD以82亿美元股票收购李飞飞创办的World Labs
news.whyEn: It is one of 2026's largest AI deals and shows chipmakers moving up into AI models to compete with Nvidia.
news.whyZh: 这是今年最大AI交易之一，显示芯片商向模型层延伸以对抗英伟达
news.detailEn: World Labs builds models that generate and simulate interactive 3D environments from text, images and video, with uses in robotics training and simulation. Li will join as executive vice president and chief scientist, reporting to CEO Lisa Su. AMD had backed a $1 billion round for World Labs at a $5 billion valuation seven months ago. The all-stock deal is expected to close by year-end pending regulatory approval.
news.detailZh: World Labs开发能根据文字、图片和视频生成、模拟可交互3D环境的「世界模型」，可用于机器人训练和仿真。李飞飞将出任AMD执行副总裁兼首席科学家，向CEO苏姿丰汇报。七个月前AMD曾参与World Labs估值50亿美元的10亿美元融资。这笔全股票交易预计年底前完成，尚需监管批准。

news.titleEn: Trump 'very seriously' considering diesel export ban as global supply crunch worsens
news.conclusionEn: Trump said he is "very seriously" weighing a ban on US diesel exports as record fuel prices pile pressure on him before the midterms.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普称「非常认真」考虑禁止美国柴油出口
news.whyEn: A ban could tighten global diesel supply, especially for Europe, and may backfire by raising US gasoline prices.
news.whyZh: 禁令或令全球尤其欧洲柴油更紧缺，还可能反推美国汽油价格上涨
news.detailEn: US diesel hit a record $6.53 a gallon on Sept. 22 and has eased only slightly since. Energy Secretary Chris Wright has suggested restrictions rather than an outright ban, while Politico reported a possible 90-day ban plan. Refiners such as Valero and Marathon Petroleum and diesel futures rose on the comments. Industry groups and former officials warn the move makes little economic sense.
news.detailZh: 美国柴油价格9月22日创下每加仑6.53美元纪录，之后仅小幅回落。能源部长赖特暗示可能是限制而非全面禁止，Politico则报道政府在准备为期90天的禁令方案。消息传出后Valero、马拉松石油等炼油股及柴油期货上涨。行业团体和前官员警告，此举在经济上并不合理。

news.titleEn: RTX Wins $21 Billion US Agreement for Air-to-Air Missile Output
news.conclusionEn: The Pentagon awarded RTX's Raytheon a multiyear contract worth up to $20.7 billion to speed up AMRAAM missile production.
news.conclusionZh: 五角大楼授予雷神最高207亿美元AMRAAM导弹合同
news.whyEn: It reflects urgent efforts to rebuild missile stockpiles drained by the Middle East and Ukraine wars, boosting defense contractors.
news.whyZh: 反映美国急于补充被中东和乌克兰战事消耗的导弹库存，利好军工股
news.detailEn: The five-year deal, with two option years, covers production for the US and 16 foreign customers under the Pentagon's "Arsenal of Freedom" program. AMRAAM is fielded by 44 countries and is the main interceptor for the NASAMS air-defense system. RTX has set a goal of at least 1,900 AMRAAMs a year after nearly doubling output in 2025. Multiyear contracts give suppliers the certainty to invest in capacity.
news.detailZh: 这份五年期合同另含两年选择期，属于五角大楼「自由军火库」计划，涵盖美国及16个外国客户。AMRAAM导弹已部署于44个国家，也是NASAMS防空系统的主要拦截弹。RTX在2025年产量几乎翻倍后，定下年产至少1900枚的目标。多年期合同让供应商有信心投资扩产。

news.titleEn: Rubio meets Saudi FM as fight against Yemen's Houthis intensifies
news.conclusionEn: US Secretary of State Rubio met Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal in Washington as Houthi advances and missile attacks on Saudi Arabia escalate.
news.conclusionZh: 鲁比奥会见沙特外长，也门胡塞武装攻势升级
news.whyEn: Houthi control of Yemen's western coast threatens shipping through Bab el-Mandeb, adding a second chokepoint risk alongside Hormuz.
news.whyZh: 胡塞控制也门西海岸威胁曼德海峡航运，与霍尔木兹形成双重风险
news.detailEn: The Houthis launched a major offensive this month and seized Yemen's Red Sea coast from Saudi-backed government forces. Saudi Arabia said it intercepted two drones and two ballistic missiles fired from Yemen on Saturday. Riyadh has sought US military help, but Washington has so far avoided direct strikes, offering intelligence and targeting support instead. Any disruption at Bab el-Mandeb would further squeeze global energy and container shipping.
news.detailZh: 胡塞武装本月发动大规模攻势，从沙特支持的政府军手中夺取了也门红海沿岸。沙特称周六拦截了从也门发射的两架无人机和两枚弹道导弹。利雅得寻求美国军事援助，但华盛顿至今避免直接打击，只提供情报和目标支持。一旦曼德海峡受阻，全球能源和集装箱航运将进一步承压。

news.titleEn: SpaceX's supersized Starship launches into orbit for the first time
news.conclusionEn: SpaceX's Starship reached orbit for the first time on its 14th test flight and deployed 26 Starlink satellites, its first operational payload.
news.conclusionZh: SpaceX星舰第14次试飞首次入轨并部署26颗星链卫星
news.whyEn: Reaching orbit is a key step toward cheaper heavy-lift launches, NASA's Moon missions and SpaceX's commercial valuation.
news.whyZh: 入轨是迈向低成本重型发射、NASA登月任务及提升SpaceX估值的关键一步
news.detailEn: Starship lifted off from Starbase, Texas, at 8:46 a.m. EDT on Monday. One Raptor 3 engine shut down unexpectedly on ascent, but the ship relit an engine to complete its push into orbit. Flight controllers chose to bring it down sooner than the planned six orbits, after a couple of laps, with splashdown in the Pacific. The flight moves SpaceX closer to routine operational missions.
news.detailZh: 星舰于美东时间周一上午8:46从德州星港发射。上升过程中一台猛禽3发动机意外关机，但飞船重新点火完成入轨。飞控团队出于稳妥考虑，未按计划绕地球六圈，而是飞行几圈后提前返回，在太平洋溅落。此次飞行让SpaceX离常态化运营任务更近一步。

news.titleEn: U.K. probes suspected Iran or Russia link in foiled plot near U.S. base
news.conclusionEn: British police are investigating possible foreign-state links after arresting five men near RAF Fairford, a base used for US strikes on Iran.
news.conclusionZh: 英国调查美军所用空军基地附近未遂袭击是否涉伊朗或俄罗斯
news.whyEn: It shows the Iran war spilling into Europe and raises security risks for allies hosting US forces.
news.whyZh: 表明伊朗战争外溢至欧洲，接纳美军的盟国安全风险上升
news.detailEn: Police intercepted suspicious vehicles heading toward RAF Fairford early Sunday and arrested five British men in their mid-twenties on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offences; they were later released on bail. Counter-terrorism chief Laurence Taylor said officers are examining whether proxies were working for a foreign state. Iran has denied involvement, though its IRGC said in July that any base used against Iran is a legitimate target.
news.detailZh: 警方周日凌晨拦截驶向费尔福德空军基地的可疑车辆，以涉嫌爆炸物和恐怖主义罪名逮捕五名20多岁的英国男子，随后他们获保释。反恐负责人劳伦斯·泰勒表示，警方正调查是否有代理人为外国政府行事。伊朗否认参与，但伊朗革命卫队7月曾声称任何被用于攻击伊朗的基地都是合法目标。

businessTips.explanationEn: The Eisenhower Matrix sorts tasks into four boxes by urgency and importance: do now, schedule, delegate, or drop. Its key insight is that urgent tasks crowd out important-but-not-urgent work like strategy, hiring and relationships. Managers who deliberately protect time for the second box tend to prevent future crises instead of fighting them.
businessTips.explanationZh: 艾森豪威尔矩阵按「紧急」和「重要」两个维度把任务分成四格：马上做、排期做、交给别人做、直接放弃。它的核心洞见是，紧急的事会挤掉「重要但不紧急」的工作，比如战略、招聘和维护关系。刻意为第二象限留出时间的管理者，更能预防危机而不是疲于救火。
businessTips.exampleEn: A small-business owner lists everything on her plate on Monday. Replying to routine emails goes to an assistant, a cold-lead report gets dropped, and two hours every Thursday are blocked for improving the pricing strategy.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位小店老板周一把所有待办列出来：日常邮件交给助理，一份没人看的线索报表直接砍掉，每周四固定留出两小时优化定价策略。

businessTips.explanationEn: Building in public means openly sharing your progress, numbers, mistakes and lessons while creating a product or side business. It turns the building process itself into marketing, attracting an audience before launch. It also creates accountability and early feedback, so you learn what people want sooner. The trade-off is that competitors can see your moves, so share lessons rather than every secret.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「公开构建」指在做产品或副业的过程中，公开分享进度、数据、失误和心得。它把建设过程本身变成营销，在上线前就积累受众。同时带来自我约束和早期反馈，让你更快知道用户想要什么。代价是竞争对手也能看到你的动作，所以要分享经验，而不是交出所有核心机密。
businessTips.exampleEn: A developer building a budgeting app posts weekly updates on X with signups, revenue and one lesson learned. By launch day, 800 followers are on the waitlist and several suggested features are already built.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一名开发者做记账App时，每周在社交平台发布注册数、收入和一条心得。到上线那天，已有800人在等候名单上，好几个网友建议的功能也已做好。

businessTips.explanationEn: A share buyback is when a company uses cash to repurchase its own stock, reducing the number of shares outstanding. With fewer shares, each remaining share owns a bigger slice of profits, which lifts earnings per share. Buybacks are a flexible alternative to dividends, but they only create value if the stock is bought below its intrinsic worth. Investors should also check whether buybacks merely offset dilution from employee stock grants.
businessTips.explanationZh: 股票回购是公司用现金买回自家股票，减少流通股数量。股数变少后，每股分到的利润更多，每股收益随之提高。回购是比分红更灵活的回报方式，但只有在股价低于内在价值时回购才真正创造价值。投资者还应留意，回购是否只是在抵消员工股权激励带来的稀释。
businessTips.exampleEn: Nvidia just added $150 billion to its buyback plan. If a company with 1 billion shares earning $10 billion retires 5% of its shares, EPS rises from $10 to about $10.53 even with flat profits.
businessTips.exampleZh: 英伟达刚追加1500亿美元回购。假设一家公司有10亿股、年利润100亿美元，回购注销5%股份后，即使利润不变，每股收益也会从10美元升至约10.53美元。
